_about: What the server and the page's script say in this language. A machine-assisted draft that no native speaker has reviewed yet; corrections are welcome. review_notes lists the choices most worth checking.
review_notes: Repeats 伴侶 instead of a singular pronoun; 它 only in Kuyda's quote; White Kitsuné = 白狐戰士; Act I 'Exist' = 成立; 'Prices in dollars' = 以美元標價; join reads 與其他 N 人一起加入.
